title: Implementing an agent by hand, from scratch

videos.script: Every agent SDK in the next three lessons is a version of one loop. This lesson writes that loop, from scratch, in one file of a hundred and eighty-three lines. {{title}} It has four parts. Tools made from ordinary Python functions, where the type hints become the schema. A model behind a single method, so the provider can be swapped and the tests need none. The loop, with its budget and its guards. And a trace of every step, with timings. {{parts}} You will run it on three of Marginalia's messages. An order id typed without its hyphen, which the schema refuses and the model corrects. A refund the agent asks for and the host refuses, because nobody confirmed it. And a model that keeps calling tools that do not exist, until the loop gives up and says so. {{runs}} Then the provider fails, on purpose. Twice, and the SDK retries without telling you. Three times, and the run stops. {{retries}} Last, seven tests that need no model at all. {{tests}} After this, lessons eight to ten are easier to read. Each SDK is these parts, with more around them. {{after}}
